Name: DMC Shop
Author: VegetaBul
Description:
“Water, gas and power... Comin' outta your cut. You're a real agency now.”

[b]安装说明：[/b]
[list]
[*]下载并解压到 [i]Stardew Valley > Mods[/i]
[*]可在 Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) 中设置事务所的色温，不过 Cold（偏冷）和  Warm（偏暖）的色差在游戏中并不明显
[/list]
[b]关于事务所周边元素的解释：[/b]
[list]
[*]黄色木板垃圾桶：原事务所左侧绿色木板垃圾桶和墙根黄色塑料垃圾桶的合体版
[*]“Jelly Cat 红墓市限定蓝莓猫窝”：露台空荡荡，蛋铁为了讨好Shadow狠心掏钱购买的昂贵猫窝
[*]披萨盒：仍然是蛋铁掏钱买给Shadow的pizza。嗯……他的脸上是不是又多了几道猫抓痕？
[/list]
最后，感谢 VegetaBul 和 Cotton_Spore 为事务所抛瓦谷分部的修建计划出谋划策，毕竟露台真得很大。

——————————————————————————————————————————————
[b]Installation:[/b][list]
[*]Download and extract the files into [i]Stardew Valley > Mods[/i]
[*]The colour warmth can be adjusted through [i]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/i]. Please note that the visual difference between Cold and Warm is relatively subtle in-game
[/list]
[b]Notes on Decorations: [/b][list]
[*]Yellow wooden-panel trash bin: A combination of the original  green wooden trash bin on the left side of the road and the yellow plastic bin placed against the wall.
[*]*Cough* “Jelly Cat Redgrave City Limited Blueberry Cat Bed” *Cough* *Cough*: The terrace seems a little empty, so Dante spent a considerable amount of money (where did he even get the money?) to buy an expensive cat bed to please Shadow.
[*]A Lot of pizza box: Also paid for by Dante as another offering to Shadow… Wait, are those new claw marks on his face again?
[/list]
[b]Credits:[/b] Special thanks to VegetaBul and Cotton_Spore for contributing ideas to theshop planning. After all, the terrace is really quite large.
